A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same VISA paper and complete supplementary Sections A-H. Text and rendered-page comparisons support reliable matching of the methods, equations, figures, tables, and references.

before.justification: v1 reports original VISA experiments on Action Genome and PVSG/4DPVSG, including benchmark comparisons, ablations, and qualitative analyses in Section 4 and the supplement.

after.justification: v2 retains the same original benchmark results, ablations, parameter studies, and qualitative analyses, including the supplementary results.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the identical VISA procedure, including MGSM, IRG, HSE, losses, and training/testing steps. No method component or operation changes.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same Action Genome PREDCLS, SGCLS, and SGDET tasks and the same PVSG/4DPVSG coverage, including PSG4D-GTA and PSG4D-HOI.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in Tables 1, 5, 6, and 16. FloCoDe remains the same evaluated baseline; its reference entry changes only venue metadata.

E3.justification: The task definitions, constraint regimes, mR@K/R@K metrics, model configurations, training settings, and evaluation procedures remain identical in Section 4 and Appendices B, C, and H.

E4.justification: The MGSM/IRG/HSE ablations, lambda and iteration-count studies, feature analyses, failure cases, and supplementary visualizations are unchanged, including the extended analyses in Appendices D-F.

E5.justification: Figure 6 retains the same standard-deviation display. Neither version differs in repeated-run or seed disclosures, confidence intervals, significance testing, or other statistical reporting.

E6.justification: All numerical entries in Tables 1-16 and the qualitative results are unchanged. For example, VISA's SGCLS mR@20 and mR@50 under Semi Constraint remain 52.6 and 52.6 in Table 1.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and reasoning are identical, including the semantic debiasing derivation and Appendix A's MGSM variance, bias, and update-parameter analysis.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same dual-debiasing contributions, comparative performance claims, and claims of applicability across scene graph tasks.

C2.justification: Interpretations and limitations are unchanged, including the iteration-count/computational-cost discussion in Appendix D.3 and the four failure categories and proposed remedies in Appendix E.

D1.justification: Implementation details, hyperparameters, training resources, and reproducibility information remain unchanged in Section 4.2 and Appendices C and H. The new acknowledgment discloses funding without adding technical or access information.

R1.justification: The cited works and research positioning are unchanged. Reference [12] still identifies the same FloCoDe paper; its venue changes from CVPR to CVPR Workshops (CVPRW), a bibliographic metadata edit.

P1.justification: v2 adds a short Acknowledgments section after the conclusion, thanking three CVPR 2025 reviewers and disclosing personal funding from the corresponding author. It also updates reference [12] and the arXiv stamp; scientific prose and organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The acknowledgment block occupies previously blank space on page 9, and the longer reference [12] entry slightly reflows the bibliography on page S7. Figures, tables, captions, and their placement remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: The funding acknowledgment and reference venue update are small editorial refinements. The methods, empirical evidence, theoretical analysis, limitations, and substantive exposition are unchanged, so these edits do not produce a meaningful overall quality difference.
